statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because Monday demonstrated substantial mean reversion and fresh supplementary overnight context is near flat, while sufficiently current independent NQ path detail is not available to verify a persistent one-way move.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next evidence-heavy checkpoint is the 2026-09-15 12:30 UTC Empire State release followed by the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open; any stronger Tail state depends on observed persistent extension or failed retracements.
headline: Tail remains low overnight; Tuesday data and the cash open are the next path checkpoints
body: Monday’s Nasdaq decline narrowed materially from its opening weakness before a late second leg, demonstrating meaningful retracement capacity. The PHLX semiconductor index fell 5.9%, the 10-year Treasury yield briefly exceeded 5%, and Saudi oil-supply disruption remains unresolved. Fresh delayed overnight context is near flat, but it is not live NQ path proof.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock hours, Tail was elevated through the overnight and U.S. open, peaking at 32%, then fell as Monday delivered substantial intraday mean reversion. A late second leg briefly returned Tail to WATCH at 20:00 UTC before the 21:00-23:00 UTC assessments returned to low.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because Monday demonstrated retracement capacity and fresh supplementary overnight evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure. Conditional risk rises into Tuesday’s 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, peaking at 24% WATCH unless newly observed failed retracements justify more.

forecast.analysis: Fresh supplementary context from 22:47Z showed delayed NQ +0.04% and ES +0.06%, but no sufficiently current independent NQ path detail verifies a one-way overnight move. Monday’s strong intraday repair keeps Tail low; severe chip weakness, high yields and Saudi supply risk keep Stress extreme.

Delayed futures are supporting context, not proof of live NQ structure.
